verdicts.reason: A has the stronger hierarchy: a large headline, readable body copy and a big CTA. But the top is jumbled. The tiny SOLSTICE logo floats on the left while the product is shrunk and pushed into the top-right corner, the SUNSET SALE ribbon collides with the AWARD WINNING pill, and the missing-asset placeholder crowds the legal text. B keeps the original's order, but its headline is shrunk almost to body-copy weight, so it no longer dominates. Its three badges are scattered in a zig-zag (left, centre, right) with no shared alignment, and the missing-asset box sits right on top of the legal text.
